name: playback-speed
description: Plays music and podcasts faster or slower, each at its own speed.

speed.label: Speed
speed.description: For songs and music videos. A speed chosen in YouTube Music's menu is kept here.

podcastSpeed.label: Speed for podcasts
podcastSpeed.description: For podcast episodes. A speed chosen in YouTube Music's menu while one plays is kept here.

preservePitch.label: Keep the pitch
preservePitch.description: Off makes faster playback sound higher, like a record played too fast.
